title: Theresa May’s blast from the past calls Tories back to their unhappy place | Peter Walker
summary_full: Conservatives may instinctively want to push back against closer EU ties, but they have to train their focus elsewhere Anyone who accidentally switched to BBC One at about 9.45am on Sunday to be greeted by Theresa May awkwardly espousing the virtues of Brexit could have been forgiven for thinking they had woken up in around 2018 – and not being especially pleased at the idea.This is one of the problems now facing May’s party. For all that it is a reflex action for Conservatives to push back against closer ties with the EU, Andy Burnham’s decision to pursue such a course plunges them back into their own unhappy place.
